providers.pricingNotes: Default VM $0.036/hour (4 vCPU, 8 GB, 50 GB). Flat rate for each size; Small, Large and Xlarge are also offered. $20 monthly minimum/packs excluded; billed per second.

Pro, iad1: active CPU $0.128 per vCPU-hour of CPU time (I/O wait not billed), memory $0.0212 per GB-hour of wall time in one-minute minimum increments, $0.60 per million creations. Vercel's docs leave rounding after the first minute open; we charge whole minutes, the dearer reading. Metered: the bench stops each sandbox to read Vercel's meter before deleting it, so the meter includes the stop's disk snapshot (about 3% in one probe; approximate, not corrected per task). Hourly assumes every vCPU busy. Pro's $20 credit, data transfer and snapshot storage excluded.

providers.pricingNotes: Sandbox rates ($0.1419 per CPU-hour, $0.024 per GiB-hour; one Modal CPU is a physical core). Billed per second on max(request, usage), minimum request 0.125 CPU. Priced on the requested allocation, never on the guest's MemTotal, which shows the host's memory without a size. A sized sandbox pins request = limit, so its estimate is exact. The default track (0.125 CPU, 128 MiB request) bursts into spare host capacity and that usage is billed too, so its estimate is a lower bound. A pinned region adds 1.15x (broad, such as us) or 1.75x (narrow, such as us-east). No disk charge or creation fee listed; plan credits excluded.

Published Sandboxes runtime rates ($0.0655/vCPU-hour, $0.0211/GB RAM-hour), priced on the allocation. Billing increment and minimum not stated; one-second estimate. Free promotional period excluded. Realistic build runs mount an 8 GiB volume (fix-and-test mounts none), priced at $0.16/GB-month for the sandbox's lifetime. Snapshots and stored images not used.

Published usage rates: $0.004/vCPU-hour and $0.00225/GiB-hour of memory, per second while running (not while starting, paused or stopped). Paid plans include disk (Builder 1 TiB across machines), beyond that $0.08/GiB-month; each machine's 20 GiB /data is counted as included. Plan fee and monthly credits ($20 Pro, $100 Builder) and egress ($0.02/GiB beyond the plan's) excluded. Default agent-browser template is 4 vCPU / 8 GiB.

Published Sandboxes rates on the Performance tier, the default ($0.05/vCPU-hour, $0.01/GiB RAM-hour), priced on the allocation and billed per millisecond while running (2026-11-18). Shared ($0.011, $0.0055) and Spot ($0.0063, $0.00135) tiers are cheaper and not used. Disk not billed. The snapshot tests did not run: Beam has no API to delete a memory snapshot. Credits excluded.

Published virtual machine rates: $0.0055/vCPU-hour and $0.00275/GiB-hour of memory, per second while running, no minimum, at any size from 1 to 16 vCPU and 1 to 64 GiB; disk is included while running (small 2/4 = $0.022/hour, medium 4/8 $0.044, large 8/16 $0.088, xlarge 16/32 $0.176). A paused (asleep) sandbox costs $0.08/GB-month of disk and no compute, which these estimates leave out. Plan fee and its equal monthly usage credit ($100 on Growth) excluded.

providers.pricingNotes: Published Sandboxes rates: $0.00024/CPU-minute ($0.0144/vCPU-hour) and $0.00024/GB-minute ($0.0144/GB-hour) of the tier's memory, billed per started minute with a one-minute minimum (a 25-second 2x4 probe billed 2 CPU-minutes and 4 GB-minutes on 2026-11-24). Twelve fixed tiers, 1x2 to 12x24, 2 GB per vCPU and a 50 GB disk; the default is 2x4. Priced on the tier, not the guest: Buddy's GB are decimal, so a 2x4 guest shows 3814 MiB (3.73 GiB) and a 4x8 guest 7629 MiB (7.45 GiB), about 6.9% under the binary GiB the tier name suggests; that gap stays as an allocation caveat. Storage ($0.00011/GB-hour of used disk and snapshots, about $0.08/GB-month, not the 50 GB allocation) and the $29/month Pro plan are excluded. Buddy has no usage or billing API, so every Buddy figure is this estimate.

sourceNotes.pause-resume: Pause and resume are from the previous run (Oct 22, SDK a2316c3): the provider's own API, which the SDK update does not touch. boxd's is from its Nov 19 re-run in New York. Vercel's is from its Nov 9 run (SBX-103). Baseten's is from its own pause runs (Nov 17), timed from its first command after standby. Instabox's is from its own runs (Nov 18). Maritime's is from its own runs (Nov 24). Styne's is from its own runs (Nov 23). Buddy's is from its own runs (Nov 25). Archil's is from its own runs (Nov 23).
sourceNotes.burst-10: Maritime's bursts of 10 are from a rerun on Nov 24 on the same SDK commit (619307b), each burst started a minute apart to stay inside Maritime's create rate (30 a minute per API key). Its first bursts ran back to back, and Maritime refused the creates past that rate with HTTP 429; that run is replaced and its failures aren't counted, among them one create whose first command found Maritime's service unreachable. Buddy's bursts are from a second run on Nov 25 (02:01 UTC) on the same SDK code. Buddy allows 5,000 API requests an hour per route, resetting on the UTC hour, and our SDK checks a new sandbox's status with GET /sandboxes/{id} every 200 ms. Its first burst run started at 01:32 UTC, in the hour that also held this machine's snapshot and cost tests and the end of its main tests, and Buddy answered a burst of 10 with HTTP 429; that run is replaced and its failures aren't counted.
